q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month. Therefore, for 5 people, it would be $40 per month.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The Free plan allows you to keep up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: No, Plus subscriptions cannot be refunded after 14 days. For more information, refer to the FAQ or contact support.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: No, there is no Linux desktop app. Linux users can use the web app.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, it requires Android 12 or later. You can find the supported platforms in the FAQ.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: The web app requires an internet connection. You can use the mobile and desktop apps offline.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export. Select PDF as your export format. Your notes will be emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: SMS is not supported for two-factor authentication; we only support authenticator apps.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size on the free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep Plus until the end of the current billing period.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

answer: We reply within one business day. If you need immediate assistance, please email support@example.com.
